calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND s.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web channel and pseudo-locations
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC;
